text:
sara: FYI we just received a late vendor bill from SouthernEdge Ltd for capacity used in March. Invoice date 2025-04-03, service period 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31. Amount GBP 48,200. Need direction for March close: accrue vendor cost or wait to charge COGS in April?
miguel: Post the invoice snippet and contract ref and i'll size the accrual. Also, which GL to use for accrual?
sara: invoice snippet below, contract ref SEL-RES-2023 (billing term: vendor may bill within 45 days).
```
Invoice: SEL-2025-078
Service: Reserved capacity (Mar 2025)
Invoice date: 2025-04-03
Amount: GBP 48,200 (VAT excl)
Vendor stated FX on invoice: 1.25 USD/GBP
```
li: From revrec POV revenue recognized in March if we delivered capacity to customers. So revenue stays in Mar. We should match costs to revenue — accrue.
neha: Agree. Accrual JE: Debit COGS (6002 - Hosting COGS), Credit Accrued Liabilities (2107). Use month-end spot FX per policy: 2025-03-31 spot = 1.27 USD/GBP.
miguel: calc: 48,200 * 1.27 = 61,214.00 USD. We'll round to 61,214. Workpapers should show both invoice FX (1.25) and policy FX (1.27) with explanation.
sara: Who can approve the accrual JE? I can approve up to $50k, this is >$50k so needs L2 (Neha) sign-off.
neha: I'll review. Please prepare JE draft, upload invoice + contract clause + FX screen grab to binder.
rev-bot: Month-end binder: new file uploaded by miguel (SEL_accrual_calc_Mar2025.xlsx). :white_check_mark:
miguel: JE draft ready, filename JE_2025-03_ACCR_SEL-078.xlsx. Tagged @neha for approval.
neha: reviewed and approved. Please ensure JE description includes: "Accrual for SouthernEdge late invoice; matched to March delivery; spot FX 2025-03-31 = 1.27"
li: also add a 1-2 line note in the close memo: vendor billing lag and FX choice. auditors asked for explicit contract clause copy.
sara: done. JE posted to GL (JE# 2025-03-1123) and accrual recorded. Will reverse when invoice posts in Apr.
miguel: posted reversal template as well (for April).
sara: closing this thread for March close. thanks. :thumbsup:
